correctness.rationale: For a pure qubit state, maximal ED means every one-qubit marginal is I/2. In the two-qubit family (I tensor R_y(theta))|Phi+>, local marginals remain maximally mixed, while J_z^2=(I+Z tensor Z)/2 and the rotated Bell correlation is cos(theta), giving F_Q=2(1+cos(theta)) and hence every value in [0,4]. For even N, a tensor product of singlets has all one-body marginals I/2 and is annihilated by J_z, so F_Q=0; GHZ_N has the same one-body marginals and J_z eigenvalues plus/minus N/2, so F_Q=N^2. These calculations establish the continuous and all-even-N claims analytically; the inspected verifier is only a finite consistency check.
